name: schegent
description: Autonomously orchestrates the Claude Code CLI to drive the spec-driven development pipeline.

commands.title: Schegent: Resume Paused or Failed Workflow
Schegent: Re-detect Claude CLI prompt transport

schegent.cli.path.description: Path to the Claude CLI binary.

schegent.cli.inheritEnvironment.description: When enabled, Schegent backend CLI processes inherit the VS Code extension-host environment before Schegent-controlled variables are overlaid. Disable to spawn the backend with only Schegent-controlled variables.

schegent.cli.environmentMode.markdownDescription: Controls ambient environment forwarding to backend CLIs. `inherit` preserves the extension-host environment for compatibility; `minimal` forwards only Schegent-controlled variables; `allowlist` forwards required bootstrap variables plus the names in `schegent.cli.environmentAllowlist`. The legacy `schegent.cli.inheritEnvironment: false` always forces `minimal`. Defaults to `allowlist` with an empty list, so backend CLIs receive PATH/home/temp/locale bootstrap variables and nothing else — ambient cloud, registry, and signing credentials in the extension-host environment are not forwarded. If your setup needs `HTTPS_PROXY`, `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, or similar, add those **names** to `schegent.cli.environmentAllowlist`; set `inherit` to restore the previous behaviour.

schegent.cli.environmentAllowlist.markdownDescription: Environment variable **names** to forward when `schegent.cli.environmentMode` is `allowlist`. Values are read from the extension host at spawn time and are never stored in this setting. Required PATH/home/temp/locale/runtime bootstrap variables are included automatically.

schegent.backend.runner.description: Backend runner used to drive each phase invocation. **Permission posture differs by runner and this is the largest privilege choice in the product.** `claude` (default) spawns the Claude CLI (`schegent.cli.path`) with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`: its approval prompts are off and it acts without asking. `agy` spawns the Agy CLI the same way, adding `--output-format stream-json`. `codex` is the exception — it spawns the Codex CLI in non-interactive `exec --json` mode with `--sandbox workspace-write`, an OS-enforced bound that keeps `.git` read-only, which is also why a phase declaring `sideEffects: git` is refused on it. The prompt is piped over stdin for all backends. Per-phase overrides are part of a Phase definition in the catalog. See docs/concepts/unprompted-agent-not-contained.md for the permission decision and docs/operations/backends.md for the contract any backend must honor.

schegent.backend.probeTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds for backend availability and model-discovery probes. Timed-out probes are terminated and treated as unavailable.

schegent.codex.path.description: Path to the Codex CLI binary. Defaults to `codex` (resolved via PATH).

schegent.agy.path.description: Path to the Agy CLI binary. Defaults to `agy` (resolved via PATH).

schegent.loop.maxIterations.description: Maximum iterations for the Clarify and Analyze loop phases before force-advancing.

schegent.watchdog.pollIntervalMinutes.description: Credit watchdog poll interval in minutes.

schegent.invocation.timeoutSeconds.description: Per-phase CLI invocation timeout in seconds.

schegent.audit.rotation.sizeMB.description: Audit log rotation threshold in megabytes.

schegent.audit.rotation.maxAgeDays.description: Audit log rotation max age in days.

schegent.models.markdownDescription: Map of backend kinds to their custom model identifiers.

schegent.defaultPipelineId.markdownDescription: Pipeline id used when a feature is enqueued without an explicit selection. Empty means no default: the extension ships no pipelines, so until you import one there is nothing for this to name. Set it to the id of a pipeline you have imported.

schegent.retry.maxAttempts.markdownDescription: Maximum delayed-retry attempts per run before pausing the queue. When a phase encounters a transient error or rate limit, it schedules a delayed retry. After this many consecutive failures without a clean recovery, the run and queue are paused. Range: 1–5. Feature 056 reduced the advertised max from 20 to match the effective implementation cap (`DELAYED_RETRY_CAP = 5`).

schegent.retry.forceContinueOnCap.markdownDescription: Default for a phase's `forceContinueOnRetryCap`. When a phase's `retryCondition` is **still truthy** after its last permitted iteration, advance to the next phase instead of failing the run, and write a `[notify] forced-continue` line to the runtime log. Use this for a phase gated on something an autonomous run cannot satisfy — a manual verification step, for example — where the alternative is a loop that burns every iteration and then fails. **Whatever the condition gates is left unverified**, so the log line is the record that it was skipped. A phase's own `forceContinueOnRetryCap` overrides this. Does not apply to `failed` or `timeout` outcomes, which are terminal and never consult `retryCondition`.

schegent.queue.globalConcurrencyCap.markdownDescription: Maximum number of workflow runs that may be in-flight across the whole workspace at the same time. Each queue still runs at most one Task, so this is the ceiling on how many queues may be busy at once. A value outside the range is refused, not clamped. Range: 1–20. Concurrent local runs are authorised for a single local operator on one host process by the architecture record `docs/architecture/local-queue-parallelism-ratification.md`; concurrent runs share one working tree.

schegent.logging.verbose.markdownDescription: When enabled, each Claude CLI invocation additionally uses `--debug-file` and captures unredacted diagnostics under `<workspaceRoot>/.schegent/sessions/<runId>/diagnostics/<pipelineId>/<phaseId>/iter-<N>/` (`debug.json`, `stream.jsonl`, `verbose.log`). Claude always uses `--output-format stream-json` and `--verbose` in print mode, regardless of this setting; Codex and Agy ignore this setting. Diagnostic files are gitignored. Toggling mid-run applies to the next phase invocation only — prior invocations are not re-captured, and no extension reload is required.

schegent.logging.rawTranscriptMode.markdownDescription: Raw transcript retention policy frozen when each run starts. `always` retains every unredacted transcript; `errors-only` stages it privately and retains it only for failed, canceled, or paused runs; `off` disables raw transcript capture. Structured audit evidence remains enabled. Defaults to `errors-only`: a raw transcript is unredacted operator prompts, source, and model output, so retaining one for every successful run stores far more than diagnosis needs. Set `always` to opt back in.

schegent.logging.sessionRetentionMaxAgeD.markdownDescription: Maximum age in days for **unredacted** raw transcripts and verbose diagnostic trees. Complete inactive-run artifacts older than this are removed on activation and after terminal runs. The append-only structured audit log is never pruned by this setting.

schegent.logging.sessionRetentionMaxByte.markdownDescription: Total byte budget for **unredacted** raw transcripts and verbose diagnostic trees. Oldest complete inactive-run artifacts are removed first; the active run and structured audit log are never pruned.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogLevel.description: Runtime debug log severity filter. Records at or above the configured level are appended to the runtime log file; lower-severity records are dropped. Independent of `schegent.logging.verbose` (which controls the unredacted diagnostic sink). Re-read on every emit — mid-run changes apply at the next event boundary.
schegent.logging.runtimeLogLevel.markdownDescription: Runtime debug log severity filter. Records at or above the configured level are appended to the runtime log file; lower-severity records are dropped. Independent of `schegent.logging.verbose` (which controls the unredacted diagnostic sink). Re-read on every emit — mid-run changes apply at the next event boundary.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogFilePath.description: Runtime debug log file path. Empty string resolves to `<workspaceRoot>/.schegent/syslog`. Workspace-relative paths are accepted unless they contain `..`. Absolute paths are accepted only beneath the workspace, Schegent global storage, or the OS temporary directory; the operator home directory is not an allowed root. The parent directory is auto-created on first write; the file is created with mode 0644 on POSIX.
schegent.logging.runtimeLogFilePath.markdownDescription: Runtime debug log file path. Empty string resolves to `<workspaceRoot>/.schegent/syslog`. Workspace-relative paths are accepted unless they contain `..`. Absolute paths are accepted only beneath the workspace, Schegent global storage, or the OS temporary directory; the operator home directory is not an allowed root. The parent directory is auto-created on first write; the file is created with mode `0644` on POSIX.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogMaxBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum size in bytes of the active runtime log file before rotation. When the next write would push the file past this size, the current file is rotated to `<path>.1` and existing generations shift by one (`.1` → `.2`, ...). Range: 64 KiB–1 GiB. Default: 5 MiB. Setting changes are read on every log emit, so no extension reload is required.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogMaxGeneration.markdownDescription: Number of rotated runtime log generations to keep (`<path>.1` ... `<path>.N`). Older generations are deleted on the next rotation. Range: 0–20. Default: 3. Setting changes are read on every log emit.

schegent.fatalSignatures.markdownDescription: Operator-additive supplement to the code-resident Fatal Signature Registry. Each element is a verbatim substring; when present in CLI stdout or stderr, the active phase fails fast on the current invocation. Code-resident signatures are managed via PR review and cannot be removed or modified here. A malformed value falls back to `[]` without blocking extension activation.

schegent.claude.autoCompactPctOverride.markdownDescription: When set, the value is exported as `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` to the Claude Code CLI to override its auto-compaction threshold. Integer between 1 and 100 (percent). Leave unset to use the CLI default.

schegent.multiRoot.suppressWarning.markdownDescription: Suppress the one-shot multi-root workspace warning toast surfaced at activation. Feature 058 makes the first folder in the active `.code-workspace` the canonical Schegent workspace folder; `.schegent/` state is created there, and other folders are treated as ordinary VS Code roots. Set to `true` to hide the per-activation toast. See `repo/docs/concepts/workspace-lock.md`.

schegent.ui.confirmations.enable.markdownDescription: Show confirmation prompts for destructive UI actions (Clean All, Clear Done, Remove Item, Cancel Item, Pause/Resume, Retry Phase Now, Restart Canceled, Modify Task, Rerun History, Reset Workspace). Feature 063: when `true` (default), every destructive action opens a confirmation dialog with a per-action 'Don't ask again' checkbox; when `false`, prompts are globally disabled and destructive actions run immediately. Per-action suppression is recorded in workspace state and survives reloads. The Reset Workspace action remains unsuppressible regardless of this setting.

schegent.trust.allowCustomPhases.markdownDescription: Per-capability trust scope (feature 059). When `null` (default), the capability follows the workspace's Workspace Trust state. When `true`, saving non-default phase definitions is allowed even on an untrusted workspace _only if_ the workspace itself is trusted (the Workspace Trust ceiling is never widened). When `false`, saving non-default phase definitions is denied at the IPC layer and a `trust.capability-denied` audit event is recorded. The four-step resolution ladder is: workspace-trust ceiling → workspace-scope → user-scope → default-allow. See `repo/docs/operations/trust-scopes.md`.

schegent.trust.allowCustomRetryCondition.markdownDescription: Per-capability trust scope (feature 059) gating non-default retry-condition DSL expressions on phase rows. When `null` (default), follows Workspace Trust. When `false`, any save that introduces a non-default `retryCondition` on any phase row is denied at the IPC layer; the row's default retry-condition is unaffected. The Workspace Trust ceiling is never widened. See `repo/docs/operations/trust-scopes.md`.
